results.title: Muzej Mimara - Ronald Aleksander Lindgreen - Kratko razdoblje starenja
results.description: The works he has created since he returned to Croatia in 2012, from oil paintings to watercolour landscapes, illustrate his artistic development during this time period, which is closely related to how he experiences his native country. In the last ten years, he has changed and evolved as an artist. Coming to Croatia from the Netherlands – a tidy and flat country – opened his eyes to nature and landscapes.
